goal: Move the four eggs from the egg basket into the egg holder (an articulated tray with a lid), close the lid, and return the arm home.
instruction_templates: Place the four eggs from the basket into the egg holder, then close the lid.
success: For each egg target0, target1, target2, target3: the egg's root origin xy lies inside egg_holder's bbox footprint (convex hull of the oriented bbox projected on xy) and its root z is above the egg_holder's bbox lowest z (is_A_in_B).

For each of the four eggs: egg root z minus the z of egg_holder's passive functional point 'bottom' is strictly between 0.01 m and 0.04 m (is_A_point_above_B_point_by_z_range, z_lower default 0.01, z_upper 0.04): the egg must sit in a holder cup/slot, resting just above the bottom point (not on top of the lid or floating).

The egg_holder's lid joint (joint(s) listed under the passive functional entry 'GetParentLink' of the egg_holder asset) has normalised position (position - lower)/(upper - lower) > 0.9 for at least one such joint, i.e. the lid is more than 90 percent of its joint range (which end of the range is 'closed' is defined by the asset's limits; the task intends this to be the closed lid).
All target robots back at start end-effector pose: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m and rotation <= 20 degrees (all_robot_back_to_origin defaults).
evaluation: Checked after every action; all conditions must hold at the same step (4 eggs in place, lid > 90 percent of range, arm home); the first such step is success. Fails at step_lim=700 actions. No early-fail rule. Process score (partial only): transition mode with scores 10/25/40/90 for 1/2/3/4 eggs in place and grippers open (>= 0.8); success gives the final 100 tier via reward.
objects: egg_basket: egg basket (Geometry, category egg_basket), 1, on the table, x in [-0.4,0.4], y in [-0.2,-0.1], random yaw within +/-30 deg.

target0..target3: eggs (category egg), 4, start in/on the basket: positions relative to the basket's plane 'egg_basket/egg_basket/0', x,y in [-0.1,0.1] (basket-local), random yaw +/-45 deg, margin 0 (so they may touch).

egg_holder: egg holder with hinged lid (Articulation, category egg_holder), 1, on the table, x in [-0.05,0.05], y in [-0.2,-0.1] (near the centre), initial lid state is whatever the asset's default is (presumably open, not determinable statically).
end_requirements: Target arms back within 0.15 m per axis and 20 degrees of start end-effector pose at the moment of success; the lid must be closed (joint ratio > 0.9).
physics_kind: mixed (rigid eggs + articulated egg holder with a hinged lid)
notes: Lid condition uses the joint ratio of the joint named in the asset's functional metadata ('GetParentLink'); the direction (which end is 'closed') cannot be determined statically. The egg height window (0.01 m < z_egg - z_bottom_point < 0.04 m) is tight: eggs must be seated in the holder. The same egg_holder 'bottom' functional point (possibly several points; any point passing counts per egg) is used for all 4 eggs. Eggs are matched to any slot (no per-slot assignment).
